purpose: 410 realistic Japanese word inputs and 38 rejection/ambiguity controls. Expected readings are curated test inputs, never newly invented dictionary evidence. Acceptance is asserted only for recorded source-backed meanings; unresolved cases remain explicitly marked. This tests candidate eligibility, not valid game turns.

source.attribution: Japanese Wiktionary contributors; extraction by Kaikki.org/Wiktextract

policy.note: Person/character/verb/adjective senses remain excluded. A valid ordinary noun or place sharing the reading remains independently eligible.
